1.full_quote: No, no, no, no, no, no, no. You sing in tune. You don't want to do auto tune because that's where your spirit is and you don't want to change that. It's one thing for the tracks to be synthesized, but you don't want your own voice. You don't want your breath to be synthesized. You want that full energy to go out to the people.
1.why_it_hooks: A working artist reaching for auto-tune gets told no on the spot, with the reasoning laid out in one breath — a real objection handled live, not a lecture.
1.suggested_caption: Your voice is the one thing that shouldn't be synthesized.
1.topic: The Role of the Singer / Performer Identity
